{{Quote|All units: That shield is strong enough to nullify our bombardment. All air and ground units will attack the base via the southern valley. Once you smash through their defenses, penetrate the shield, enter the droid control center, and shut down the droids and the shield.|Admiral Jonoin|<ref name="Point Blank" />}}
'''Jonoin''' was an individual who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the latter stages of the conflict, Jonoin lead a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Garia|attack]] on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Separatist base (Garia)|base]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garia]]. Jonoin's forces carried out an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the base, but their strike was unsuccessful, so the Admiral ordered a ground assault against the facility.

==Biography==
Jonoin was an individual who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Point Blank" /> an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] conflict that was fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Sometime near the end of the war, Jonoin commanded Republic forces during an [[Battle of Garia|attack]] on a [[Separatist base (Garia)|Confederate base]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garia]], in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. Jonoin's forces carried out an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the base, but the strike was unsuccessful because the base was protected by [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shields]]. The Admiral was therefore forced to alter the battle plan. Jonoin contacted all of the Republic units participating in the attack and ordered a ground assault on the base's control center to destroy the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] stationed there and shut down the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]].<ref name="Point Blank" />

Republic ground forces landed on Garia, and a number of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] began to approach the command center. However, Confederacy fire inflicted heavy damage onto the walkers, so Jonoin ordered a group of Republic [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] to assist the lead AT-TE, which had been rendered immobile near the base.<ref name="Point Blank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jonoin was mentioned in ''[[Point Blank]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] scenario that was written by [[Sterling Hershey]] and released in [[2010]] on the website [[Wizards.com]]. Jonoin's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and [[Species/Legends|species]] are not revealed in the scenario.<ref name="Point Blank" />
